svg.aria-label: MinuteGenius pipeline: a meeting recording is split into what was shown (keyframes analyzed by a vision model) and what was said (on-device transcription and speaker identification), merged into one timeline, then written up by an LLM into a structured report.
svg.title: How MinuteGenius works
